description: Generate a palette from a base color and harmony scheme. Use for design prototypes; defaults: random base, triadic scheme, five hex colors. Returns {base, scheme, colors, textOnBase}; text color is heuristic, not a WCAG contrast check.

format.description: Output color notation: hex, rgb or hsl.

scheme.description: Palette harmony algorithm: complementary, triadic, tetradic, analogous, monochrome or random.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for repeatable palette generation.

name: generate-color
title: Generate an illustrative color palette
